text.text_excerpt: Loved the happy hour with 1$ oysters on the rock they were large and perfect! Our next app was the bbq crab claws holy cow that sauce was amazing. The hush puppies were yum with the dipping sauce. Loved my shrimp and turkey neck but small and very pricey. Great service super hip vibe but I worry what they will thrive off of once crawfish boiled season is over :/ also super small outdoor tables we had food on side chairs ?! Flies outside and fans didn't work which was kinda nasty I'd sit inside. All in all, loved my food and love supporting new local places! But I hope to see menu expand and come back to try more.

Love, love LOVE Seafood Sally's! Met a friend for lunch there and immediately fell for the restaurant's charm and peaceful vibe. We started with a 1/2 dozen oysters and some onion rings. The oysters were absolutely scrumptious and the onions rings were battered and fried to a crunchy perfection. We of course had to try the sautéed crab fingers and Matty's Shrimp Dip. I'll be honest the crab fingers were not my favorite I found them overly rich. Matty's Shrimp Dip however is utterly divine! Serious, it was creamy, balance in its flavor profile and just the right amount of shrimp for texture. As our main we decided to split the Captain's Platter and I love me some cornmeal fried goodness. T...

Wowwwoow!!! SO good! This new seafood restaurant located on popular Oak St is soon to be our fave. We sat at the bar and had the most attentive service for as busy as they were. The menu is fairly expansive and the atmosphere is airy and relaxing. They have outside seating too for those lovely spring evenings where you can sip their fancy cocktails and slurp oysters. We had the Cesar salad and added buttered crab then tried the cornmeal fried oyster and shrimp platter. Since it was warm out, we had their chilled red wine then switched to rose.
